name: dgate
description: Model-agnostic local SQLite Decision Gate & Multi-Agent Orchestration Engine + TUI

scripts.dgate-tui: sh -c 'if [ -x ./target/release/dgate-tui ]; then exec ./target/release/dgate-tui "$@"; elif [ -x ./target/debug/dgate-tui ]; then exec ./target/debug/dgate-tui "$@"; else exec cargo run --release -p dgate-tui -- "$@"; fi' --
scripts.dgate-gui: sh -c 'if [ -x ./target/release/dgate-gui ]; then exec ./target/release/dgate-gui "$@"; elif [ -x ./target/debug/dgate-gui ]; then exec ./target/debug/dgate-gui "$@"; else exec cargo run --release -p dgate-gui -- "$@"; fi' --
